claim: Independent from-scratch QuantConnect backtest of Zarattini/Aziz/Mele (2025)'s dual-VIX-signal strategy. eVRP_t = VIX_t - eRV30_t, eRV30 = std(trailing ~10 daily SPY returns, ddof=1) * sqrt(252) * 100. Signal 2 is VIX vs VIX3M. Four cases mapped to a target_weight on VIXY: (1) eVRP>0 & VIX<VIX3M -> target_weight=-VIX/100 (full short-vol); (2) eVRP<0 & VIX<VIX3M -> target_weight=-0.5*VIX/100 (half short-vol); (3) eVRP<0 & VIX>VIX3M -> target_weight=+VIX/100 (full long-vol); (4) else -> target_weight=0 (cash). Remaining capital held in SPY only while short-vol (cases 1/2); fully cash otherwise. Backtested 2016-01 to 2026-07: Sharpe 0.729 vs SPY buy-and-hold Sharpe 0.582. Parameter grid (RV window 6-14 days x rebalance threshold 1-5%, 25 combos) all beat SPY's Sharpe, range 0.713-0.773; grid mean 0.746, max 0.773 at (14-day window, 3% threshold); default (10-day, 2%) gives the reported 0.729.
quote: if e_vrp > 0 and self._vix.price < self._vix3m.price: # Case 1: Full short-vol conviction target_weight = -self._vix.price / 100 elif e_vrp < 0 and self._vix.price < self._vix3m.price: # Case 2: Medium short-vol conviction (half size) target_weight = -0.5 * self._vix.price / 100 elif e_vrp < 0 and self._vix.price > self._vix3m.price: # Case 3: Full long-vol conviction target_weight = self._vix.price / 100 else: # Case 4: Cash (conflicting signals or eVRP == 0) target_weight = 0
applicability: Primary source for this iteration's signal formulas, case logic and VIX/100 position-sizing rule; our long-only-ETP version drops case 3 (long-vol) entirely (no VIXY/UVXY long leg permitted by the brief) and expresses the short-vol leg on SVXY (1x weight = VIX/100, not QC's suggested 2x SVXY-beta-matching) instead of short VIXY.
limitations: Not the original paper -- an independent third-party replication, not the paywalled SSRN full text. Uses VIXY, not SVXY, as its tradable short-vol instrument; the paper's own precise 'Strategy 3 vs Strategy 4' sizing distinction is only known through this secondary source.
independent_replication: Cross-checked against concretum_group_volatility_edge_blog (author-affiliated summary) and ssrn_5316487_abstract_via_search_snippet (search-engine snippet of the abstract page) -- both report a materially positive Sharpe/CAGR from the same 2-signal mechanism over a different (2008-2025) window.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the eVRP formula, the 4-case decision table and the VIX/100 (and 0.5x/100) sizing rule used in scripts/screen_batches/h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp.py's candidate-manifest.json.

quote: The authors test four rule sets, beginning with a constant short-volatility allocation and ending with a dynamically sized strategy that responds to both the option-market premium and the slope of the VIX term structure.
